## Buns and organs
Cut a whole bun with a knife to separate its top and bottom for stacked burgers. Microwave recipes use a whole bun.
A human appendix is obtained through torso surgery: open the ribcage, then choose Remove appendix and use the indicated surgical tools. Ordinary wasteland animals do not supply one. Butchering N14 wasteland animals supplies animal brains; brain burgers accept these as well as humanoid brains. Fish burgers accept raw redfish and whitefish fillets.
